description: Road incidents a TRAFFIC CAMERA SAW and a vision model CONFIRMED, in force now: near a point (`near` [lat, lon] with `radius_m`, default 1000, at most 10000), in a `bbox` [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], or along a route `shape` (polyline6 from `route`, corridor `buffer_m` default 60). Give exactly one. Each record says what it asserts (`closed` or a `speed_override` in km/h) on which OSM ways and carriageway, what was seen (collision, stalled vehicle, wrong-way vehicle), the camera, the clip URL the verdict was made on (`evidence_url`), the verifier and its `confidence`, and when it lifts (`end`, always within minutes: these records expire on their own). Camera records RANK BELOW official closures and never retract one. READ `coverage_note` ALOUD: an empty list means no camera-verified incident here, NEVER a clear road. Show `attribution` verbatim (Powered by TfL Open Data). Off unless the deployment arms camera incidents (SN_CAMERA_INCIDENTS_ENABLED): an unarmed gateway answers 501 and says so. Requires the MapMap gateway (GATEWAY_URL + GATEWAY_API_KEY).

include_recently_expired.description:
Include records that have expired in the last hour, for the
operator's timeline (default false).

shape.description:
A route shape as polyline6; the corridor rule of
`/v1/incidents/along` applies (`buffer_m` default 60).

name: camera_incidents

arc_m.description: Distance along the route, metres, when queried by `shape`.

evidence_url.description: The clip the decision was made on.

Direction.description:
Carriageway of a way, spelled as the artefact spells it. A serde
twin of [`WayDirection`], which deliberately carries no serde.

IncidentKind.description:
What kind of road event an incident describes, as far as a closure
decision cares.

oneOf.description: Two or more vehicles made contact.
A vehicle stopped where it should not have.
A vehicle travelling against the carriageway direction.
Anything else, carrying the raw category for logs.

attribution.description: Attribution lines required by the camera providers, verbatim.

coverage_note.description:
Plain-language statement of which cameras are covered and that
camera records rank below official closures. Agents must read it
aloud: an empty list means "no camera-verified incident", never
"road clear".

incidents.description: Records in force (and recently expired, if asked).
